# ForexGoldEA - The Gold Desk

> ForexGoldEA publishes plain-English education about trading gold (XAU/USD): what moves the metal, how the arithmetic of pips, lots, spread and leverage actually works, the psychology that decides most outcomes, and what changes when an Expert Advisor trades it for you. The site also offers ForexGoldEA, a rules-based XAU/USD expert advisor for MetaTrader 4 and 5, free to traders who open an account through the partner broker link. Editorial focus is the gold market and the trader; deep MT4/MT5 engineering topics are not this site's focus.

Key facts:
- Editorial scope: gold market education - drivers, sessions, position-size arithmetic, trading psychology, and an honest account of what automation does and does not solve
- Product: ForexGoldEA, a rules-based XAU/USD expert advisor for MT4 and MT5, with a fixed stop-loss on every trade and user-set risk limits (no martingale, no grid without stops)
- Company: BBFxAi LLC
- Pricing: free when you open and fund an account through the partner broker link
- Contact: Telegram https://t.me/BBFx_Ai - community https://t.me/BBFxAi_Community
- Performance: tracked on a live Myfxbook account; message Telegram @BBFx_Ai for the link
- Important: trading gold on margin carries a high level of risk and a large majority of retail CFD accounts lose money. Nothing here is financial advice, and no result is guaranteed.

- [How much is a pip in gold? XAUUSD pip & point value explained](https://forexgoldea.com/how-much-is-a-pip-in-gold-xauusd.html): A pip on gold is usually a $0.10 move — about $1 per pip at 0.01 lots. Pip vs point cleared up, with a value table for every lot size.
